name: BigCommerce
one_liner: SaaS commerce platform whose store APIs manage product catalogs, orders, customers, and storefront experiences.
auth_notes: Store-level (merchant-created static access_token), app-level (per-store token after install) and account-level OAuth API accounts. Store Management MCP uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.
access_notes: Merchants create store-level credentials in their control panel; sandbox stores are created via the BigCommerce Partner Portal (partner sign-in). Rate limits vary by store plan.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST and GraphQL APIs with OAuth, webhooks and partner sandbox, but per-store credentials/installation, plan-dependent quotas and Partner Portal sandbox access.

needs_human_reason: Production plan pricing not verified; endpoint count not measured; Store Management MCP is early access.

identity.quote: BigCommerce offers three types of OAuth-based API accounts to developers who wish to use BigCommerce’s REST APIs

auth.quote: Merchants generate single-store API credentials when they create API accounts in their store control panel

access.quote: The maximum quota varies by store plan and requested resources.

sandbox.quote: Sandbox stores are intended for developing and testing apps.
They cannot process any live transactions.

api_surface.quote: Webhooks notify applications when specific events occur on a BigCommerce store.
Each API request consumes one quota unit.

mcp.quote: BigCommerce supports MCP in three ways.

disputes.why: Dedicated rate-limits page: quota refreshed every 30s, varies by plan, 429 handling.
Separate catalog, orders, customers, carts, webhooks, storefront GraphQL APIs; count not measured.
